import instructor

    age: int

    model="gpt-4o",
    response_model=User,
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Alice is 28 years old."}]
)

entries.name: Smolagents
entries.summary: Hugging Face's lightweight Python-first agent library where agents write executable Python code directly instead of parsing JSON action strings. Under the hood, it incorporates codeAgent execution loop running in a secure Python sandbox. Key technical highlights include: 30% fewer token overhead and higher tool success rate on GAIA benchmarks. Licensed under the Apache-2.0 license, it integrates seamlessly into contemporary AI engineering toolchains.
entries.architecture: CodeAgent execution loop running in a secure Python sandbox.
entries.usage:
from smolagents import CodeAgent, HfApiModel, DuckDuckGoSearchTool
agent = CodeAgent(tools=[DuckDuckGoSearchTool()], model=HfApiModel())
agent.run("What is the latest score of the Mars Rover mission?")
entries.benchmarks: 30% fewer token overhead and higher tool success rate on GAIA benchmarks.
entries.limitations: Code execution requires sandbox container isolation for untrusted user inputs.

entries.name: SmolLM2-1.7B
entries.summary: Hugging Face's compact small language model designed for efficient local on-device deployment, pre-trained on 11 trillion tokens including FineWeb-Edu, DCLM, and Stack-Edu, and fine-tuned with DPO, incorporating an architecture of transformer decoder optimized with grouped-query attention (GQA), rotary positional embeddings (RoPE), and SwiGLU activations for mobile and edge inference. The model demonstrates competitive performance across verified evaluations, including MMLU: 54.8%, GSM8k: 64.9%, HumanEval: 49.4%, IFEval: 62.4%. With its 1.7B Parameters · 8k Context design, it supports diverse local and enterprise deployment profiles under the Apache-2.0 license.
entries.architecture: Transformer decoder optimized with grouped-query attention (GQA), rotary positional embeddings (RoPE), and SwiGLU activations for mobile and edge inference.
entries.usage:
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer

model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct", device_map="auto")
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct")

inputs = tokenizer("Explain quantum computing simply:", return_tensors="pt").to(model.device)
output = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=100)
entries.limitations: Compact parameter capacity limits deep domain synthesis compared to 70B+ models; best suited for targeted agent loops, mobile, and on-device NLP.

entries.name: Supabase Vector
entries.summary: Supabase's open-source vector database toolkit built on PostgreSQL and pgvector, enabling developers to store, index (HNSW / IVFFlat), and query high-dimensional embeddings directly within Postgres. Its cloud and infrastructure runtime provides postgreSQL database engine extended with pgvector C extension, pg_ivm, Row Level Security (RLS), and unified TypeScript/Python SDK clients. Core platform telemetry and performance features include: Supports sub-10ms similarity searches on millions of vectors using HNSW indexing; fully integrates with relational tables, foreign keys, and ACID transactions. Accessible under a Apache-2.0 tier, it empowers teams to build, serve, and monitor AI workloads at scale.
